title: GoFlow
description: A concurrent job queue backend in Go — submit long-running jobs over REST, a worker pool processes them asynchronously with automatic retries and graceful shutdown, backed by PostgreSQL for persistence. Includes a live dashboard to watch jobs move through the queue in real time.

title: PocketAuth
description: A zero-dependency JWT + OAuth2 authentication microservice in pure Go. Drop-in integration for any backend. Ships with an admin UI for managing users and scopes.

title: Cartographer
description: CLI + web tool for visualising PostgreSQL schema changes across migrations. Generates interactive ER diagrams and diffs as SVG — no GUI needed.
